title: Green glass sidebar where the active item merges into the content panel (collapsed and expanded)

observed.layout: A collapsed icon rail and an expanded panel side by side on a vertical green-to-black gradient with faint sparkle dots. Expanded: leaf logo, small back chevron, five items (Home, Measure, Analyze, Reduce, Report) as translucent green capsules. The active item 'Reduce' is a white pill that extends to the right and joins the white content area with concave corners above and below. The rail mirrors the order with icon chips; the active chip is white.
observed.hierarchy: Active item is the only white element; it visually connects the menu to the content it controls.
observed.typography: Semibold sans, white on green and black on white. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Duotone/filled icons inside circular chips, consistent size.
observed.materials: Glass capsules with thin light borders over a gradient.

interpretation.aesthetic: Sustainability / carbon-tracking SaaS feel; menu order reads as a workflow (Measure, Analyze, Reduce, Report).
implementation_notes: Merged tab: active item background extends into the content surface; concave corners via radial-gradient masks or inverse-radius pseudo-elements.
Collapse: same order, labels removed, capsules become circles, width transition.
Background: linear-gradient from green to near-black.

concept_work.essence: The selected menu item physically becomes part of the page it opens.
what_makes_it_work: Collapsed state shown alongside expanded, same item order.
One-hue discipline keeps focus on the white tab.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Inactive white labels on mid-green measure about 3.2-3.4:1; rail icons about 2.7:1.
Concave joins need care at different content widths and theme changes.
No hover/focus/tooltip for the collapsed rail is shown.

pattern.name: Active item merges into content panel ('folder tab' navigation)
use_when: Sidebar where selecting a section replaces the main content
avoid_when: Content area is not visually continuous with the menu
must_preserve: Continuity between active item and content surface
adaptation_examples: Finance dashboard: navy gradient with a white merged tab.
Docs app: light theme with a tinted merged tab and neutral inactive items.
failure_modes: Concave joins break at responsive widths

lessons: Connect the active menu item to its content for instant orientation.
Show collapsed and expanded states together.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Single hue (green) gradient fading to black; white reserved for the active item and the content surface.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from the compressed image: background = dominant color in the measured box, foreground = mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels, ratio = WCAG relative-luminance contrast. Thin or anti-aliased text biases toward lower ratios; values within 0.3 of a threshold (3.0 or 4.5) are marked near_threshold and should be verified in the source file.

purpose.evidence: Menu names read as a clear process for a measurement/reduction product.

visual.evidence: Gradient, glass capsules and white merge produce a clear hierarchy.

discipline.evidence: Collapse/expand and active-state conventions are handled correctly; a back chevron is present.

usability.evidence: Both menu states shown and active item obvious; focus, hover and tooltips not shown.

consistency.evidence: Same capsule radius, icon chip and spacing across items and states.

originality.evidence: Active tab fusing with the content surface is a rare, memorable idea that also serves orientation.

evidence: primary text min 3.23:1; secondary text min n/a:1; icon min 2.67:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion, screen-reader support are not assessable from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
